market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: CL front-month settle ~$105 with strong upward momentum and Iran-driven risk premium. Reaching $115 settlement (any single day by end of June) is just +10%; given recent +$7/day moves and 2 months runway, more likely than not.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Sustained vs transient risk premium; OPEC+ output decisions.
